description: This Java class implements the ClientIdentifierReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve client identifiers and specific client identifier data from a database, using JDBC template and security context.

classes.name: ClientIdentifierReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service to read client identifier data from database.

classes.name: ClientIdentityMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation to map SQL result set to ClientIdentifierData objects.

methods.name: retrieveClientIdentifiers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of client identifiers for a given client ID, considering user security context.

methods.name: retrieveClientIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a specific client identifier by client ID and identifier ID, throws exception if not found.
